Contributing to SurveyNCD

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for your interest in SurveyNCD. Bug reports, questions, documentation fixes and code contributions are all welcome.

Reporting a problem or asking a question

Open an issue at https://github.com/StatAid-Research-Lab/SurveyNCD/issues. For a bug, please include:

  1. a minimal reproducible example (simulated data is fine; please do not post restricted survey microdata),
  2. the output of sessionInfo() and packageVersion("SurveyNCD"),
  3. what you expected and what happened.

Proposing a change

  1. Open an issue first for anything larger than a typo, so the approach can be agreed.
  2. Fork the repository and create a branch.
  3. Make your change with roxygen2 documentation (devtools::document()), and add or update tests in tests/testthat/. A change to an estimator should come with an independent check (for example a hand calculation or a comparison with another package).
  4. Run devtools::test() and devtools::check(); both should pass without new warnings or notes.
  5. Add a line to NEWS.md and open a pull request.

Scope

SurveyNCD builds on the survey package for design-based inference and aims to stay small and well tested. New features that need design-based variance estimation should use survey rather than reimplement it. Contributions for other self-reported-indicator workflows (for example risk-factor co-occurrence or care-cascade calculations) are welcome as issues for discussion first.

Support and maintenance

SurveyNCD is maintained by Sujon Mia (StatAid Research Lab). Support is on a best-effort basis; the aim is to acknowledge issues and pull requests within about two weeks. Releases are tagged on GitHub and published on CRAN, and changes are recorded in NEWS.md.

Conduct

Please be respectful and constructive. This project follows the spirit of the Contributor Covenant; unacceptable behaviour can be reported to the maintainer at the address in DESCRIPTION.
